title: logs.push request
description: plugin → companion, the payload of a `call` with op `logs.push`. The plugin hands over its own log lines and its harness's; the companion redacts them, applies the effective floors and keeps them for shipping. At most one logs.push is in flight per plugin; a second is answered `busy`, never refused.

ts.description: When the line was written, RFC 3339.

source.description: The plugin's own line, or the harness's. The companion's own lines never ride this op.

logger.description: The logger's name inside the source.

message.description: The line. The companion redacts before it clips to the stored bound.

attrs.description: The line's extra attributes; every value is redacted before it is encoded.
